name: development-go
description: Go maintenance plugin — the core loop of the #868 full-maintenance epic. Dispatches findings from /development:maintenance to per-tool agents: go-format-lint-fixer (golangci-lint v2, one pinned binary doing both `fmt` and `run --fix`), go-maintenance-planner, and go-ci-fixer. Blessed toolchain: Go modules, Taskfile, golangci-lint v2, go test -coverprofile, buf + grpc-gateway, ko. Static-analysis triage, coverage, bootstrap, vendor PRs, the approver, and the platform advisors land in later slices of #868.
